package.name: franka_streaming_impedance_controller
package.description: Streaming Cartesian impedance control for the Franka FR3: a ros2_control torque controller driven by absolutely-timed pose chunks, which it splices without stopping so a chunked reference (a policy's action chunks, a planner's path) survives to the joint level. Ships with a Franka Hand driver that talks to libfranka directly rather than through franka_gripper. Control law ported from serl_franka_controllers; reference generator ported from UMI's PoseTrajectoryInterpolator.
